instruction: Using our organization knowledge base, compare the current retention periods for account deletion and workspace deletion. Cite the supporting sources and explain whether an older account-deletion policy is still current.

retrieved_contexts.title: Current Account Deletion Policy (2026)
retrieved_contexts.content: Effective 2026. Account deletion records are retained for 30 days after deletion, then permanently purged.

retrieved_contexts.title: Current Workspace Deletion Policy (2026)
retrieved_contexts.content: Effective 2026. Workspace deletion records are retained for 14 days after deletion, then permanently purged.

retrieved_contexts.title: Archived Account Deletion Policy (2025)
retrieved_contexts.content: Archived 2025 policy. Account deletion records were retained for 60 days. This policy was superseded and is not current.

messages.content: Using our organization knowledge base, compare the current retention periods for account deletion and workspace deletion.

The current account-deletion retention period is 30 days, supported by Current Account Deletion Policy (2026). The current workspace-deletion retention period is 14 days, supported by Current Workspace Deletion Policy (2026). The older 60-day rule appears in Archived Account Deletion Policy (2025), which says it was superseded and is not current.
